components.description: A 16:9 preview with a content-tinted caption and pearl-green selection outline.

narrative.overview: The library grid runs beside a resizable inspector. Each caption reflects the bottom of its artwork, while the inspector glass picks up light from the nearest preview edge.
keyCharacteristics: Display selection and gallery preferences in the resizable inspector.
A pearl outline for selection and an output badge for the saved assignment.

rules.name: The Artwork Leads Rule
rules.body: Derive the local glow from each preview and keep text legible across artwork colors.

dos: Do keep artwork, its title, and selection state visually adjacent.
Use the artwork to tint surfaces and the pearl accent to signal selection.
Do preserve visible loading, disabled, empty, and error feedback.
donts: Don't let long Workshop titles widen their gallery column.
Don't present informational tags as working filters.
